title: Staff Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description
Role summary
The Staff Software Engineer (IC4) on Sales and Order Management designs, builds, ships, and operates capabilities whose core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored-agentic and conversational experiences that interpret a sellers or customers intent, reason over catalog, quote, and order context, invoke tools, and act on the users behalf across the quote-to-order lifecycle.
This is not a machine learning or AI research role; the engineer does not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full-stack engineering, where systems follow deterministic logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. Two consequences shape the work. First, the most important logic often lives in natural language-instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, guardrails, escalation rules-which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code. Second, because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale rather than by asserting fixed outputs, making automated evaluation a first-class engineering activity rather than a quality-assurance afterthought.
The stakes in this domain sharpen both points. An agent operating on quotes and orders touches pricing integrity, contractual commitment, and revenue recognition-a confidently wrong output is not a bad answer, it is a mispriced order. At IC4 the engineer owns AI design decisions across the domain, not within a single feature, and owns the correctness of what ships whether a person or an agent produced it.
What you do Build AI-native capability across the order lifecycle
Design and ship features built around agentic behavior-intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the users behalf-together with the data models, integrations, and channels that make them usable in production. In Order Management this spans guided offer selection and configuration, natural-language order construction and validation, conversational order status and in-flight change, order-exception triage and resolution, and promise-date and availability inquiry.
Design AI-driven autonomous workflows
Decompose sales and order processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute-determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a checkpoint with a person is required, and how exceptions, retries, and hand-back are handled. The design must make that distinction structural rather than advisory.
Author and maintain agentic instructions as engineering artifacts
Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation paths that govern agent behavior in the domain-under code review, source control, and regression coverage. Own the shared instruction and tool-description surface that adjacent teams build against.
Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic behavior
Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe - golden datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, and drift detection - plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool-selection testing.
Design conversational experiences across channels
Build experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly between automated and live agents, and behave consistently across chat and voice-accounting for what voice imposes: latency budgets, barge-in, speech recognition error, disambiguation, and explicit confirmation before consequential actions.
Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents
Convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent-sized tasks; supervise several workstreams in parallel; and review agent output for correctness, spec adherence, security, and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it.
Own quality, safety, and reliability in production
Monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool-selection error, and unsafe or unauthorized action. Defend against prompt injection and data leakage across integration surfaces. Maintain reasoning-trace observability and model rollback mechanisms, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Lead root-cause analysis when agentic behavior deviates from intent.
Ground it in solid full-stack delivery
Build the application, APIs, data models, and integrations around these capabilities-front-end experiences for sellers and order agents, server-side logic, and the connections to quoting, billing, contract, case, and fulfillment systems-with the CI/CD, observability, and upgrade-safe extensibility expected of production software.
Collaborate across product, design, and engineering
Partner with product managers, designers, conversation designers, and engineers to define success criteria and communicate capability and risk clearly. Mentor IC1 to IC3 engineers, and raise the teams practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use.
Qualifications
Required experience and skills
  • Production track record. A demonstrated record of building, shipping, and operating production software, including hands-on delivery of AI-native application features that real users depend on rather than demos or prototypes. Depth and demonstrated judgment matter more than tenure; typically around 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience.
  • Agentic delivery experience. Direct experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing AI-driven autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation and testing that verifies them. This is required, not preferred.
  • Production AI integration. Experience integrating large language model APIs and retrieval-grounded features, including agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement.
  • Domain ownership. Demonstrated ownership of a complex domain or subsystem end-to-end, including the architectural decisions, migrations, and operational consequences.
  • Engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing. Proficiency in front-end development with a modern component framework, server-side development, relational data modeling, and REST and GraphQL API design.
  • Applied machine learning literacy. A working command of the concepts that govern how these systems behave-evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic output and failure modes of modern models-sufficient to reason about, debug, and verify model-driven behavior in production.
  • Accountable use of AI coding agents. Current, effective use of AI coding assistants and agents with evidence of accountable delivery: precise specification, critical review of generated output, and verification harnesses.
  • Operational experience. Hands-on CI/CD, containerized workloads, and observability experience, plus direct on-call and incident-command experience with customer-facing systems.
  • Mentorship. Demonstrated mentorship of less-experienced engineers and a record of raising quality through code review.
  • Education. Bachelors degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus but not a substitute for a record of shipping reliable AI-native applications.
Preferred experience
  • Order and quoting domain depth. Quote-to-cash, configure-price-quote, product catalog modeling, or order management, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.
  • Evaluation and observability tooling. Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for model-driven applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale.
  • Conversation design partnership. Working alongside conversation or content designers on dialogue flow, tone, and error-recovery design.
  • Forward deployed delivery. Building against a customers data, integrations, and channels, and tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment.
  • Platform and standards depth. Industry order-management interoperability models, or Now Platform development experience: scoped applications, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Automated Test Framework, and upgrade-safe extension patterns.

Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.
About Alation
Alation is the creator of AIOS - the intelligence operating system for enterprises that cannot afford to get AI wrong. When software breaks, it throws an error. When an AI agent breaks, it produces a confident, wrong answer - and most organizations have no system to catch it before that answer drives a decision. AIOS keeps data, context, and agents in sync in one open, governed, self-improving system, so every decision an agent makes holds up.
Having pioneered the data catalog market, Alation is trusted by over 600 enterprises worldwide - including 40% of the Fortune 500 - to power their most critical data and AI initiatives. The problems we tackle are complex, high-impact, and deeply technical. This is not a slow-moving environment. We build fast, ship real things, learn from customers, and iterate relentlessly.
About the Role
AIOS doesnt work without connectivity. Agents fail when bad data reaches them, when context is stale, or when the environment shifts underneath them - and the defense against all three starts with rich, current metadata flowing in from the systems where enterprise data actually lives. Connectors are how AIOS sees the enterprise. Thats this teams job, and its getting harder and more interesting as the data and AI landscape shifts under everyones feet.
Were looking for a Senior Product Manager to own this problem end to end. Youll inherit a portfolio of 80+ integrations spanning the modern and legacy data stack, and a mandate to define what connectivity means in an agentic world - new systems, new types of sources (including the agents and AI tools that are themselves becoming metadata sources), new extraction techniques, and AI applied wherever it genuinely moves the needle.
This is a senior IC role with real scope. You wont be handed a polished roadmap or mature systems - youll sharpen the strategy, make the calls, and ship. This is a role for builders.
What Youll Do
  • Own the Connector mission: make it fast and easy for customers to bring rich, valuable metadata into AIOS
  • Drive the strategy for 80+ existing integrations - what to deepen, what to optimize, what to sunset
  • Lead expansion into new systems and entirely new categories of data sources as the AI landscape reshapes what "a data source" means
  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear direction, scoped bets, and shipped solutions
  • Talk to customers constantly - validate direction, pressure-test ideas, iterate fast
  • Work directly with engineering to define requirements, reason through tradeoffs, and move quickly
  • Apply AI strategically across the connector portfolio - both in the product and in how you work
  • Raise the bar on how we build, not just what we build
Who This Role Is For
We care more about how you operate than where youve been. Traits and trajectory matter to us more than a checklist of domain credentials.
You might be a great fit if you:
  • Are gritty and resilient - you dont stall when things are unclear or hard
  • Have a strong sense of ownership - you feel accountable for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Are deeply curious - you ask why, dig into systems, and want to understand how things really work
  • Are AI-native by instinct - you already use AI tools daily to think, write, analyze, and prototype, and you actively push the people around you to work differently
  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-expectation environments
  • Love building, especially in under-defined or shifting problem spaces
  • Make decisions with incomplete information and adjust quickly
  • Communicate clearly and align engineers, designers, and stakeholders around a direction
Experience Skills

Experience

Technical Domain Capabilities
  • Languages Toolchains: Proficient in C, C++, POSIX APIs, CMake, Make, GCC/Clang, GDB, and advanced Shell Scripting (Bash).
  • Linux Systems Programming: Deep knowledge of IPC (Unix Sockets, Shared Memory, Message Queues), Concurrency/Threading (pthreads), Asynchronous Event Loops (epoll, io_uring), Custom Daemon development, and manual Memory Management.
  • Cryptography Security: Direct API-level experience with OpenSSL/WolfSSL, TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS, X.509 PKI, PEM/DER encoding, symmetric/asymmetric ciphers, HMAC, and constant-time cryptographic programming.

Spec-Driven Methodology: Strong foundation in AI spec-driven development practices (e.g., Plan/BMAD modes) to design, map, and implement full SDLC phases.
  • AI Code Review Governance: Ability to critically inspect, profile, and audit AI-generated code for zero-trust security, memory safety, architectural integrity, and performance bottlenecks.

jobDescription:
About MG India

We are MG India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for MG. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how MG is transforming as a business.
About MG

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

Key responsibilities
- Lead the end to end oversight cycle, including onboarding of third party suppliers and asset managers, conducting periodic suppliers reviews, ongoing monitoring, and exit/transition management
- Ensure, both at onboarding and throughout the life cycle of the relationship, oversight is performed in line with MG s third party financial crime due diligence requirements in addition to any local jurisdictional requirements
- Conduct day to day operational oversight of relationships
- Maintain visibility of supplier performance, risk exposures, and compliance against contractual obligations and service-level agreements (SLAs)
- Conduct comprehensive ODD reviews of all suppliers in line with LIO s framework, including internally and externally appointed investment managers, covering operational capabilities, governance structures, risk management practices, IT systems, cybersecurity controls, business continuity, and financial stability
- Perform initial and ongoing risk based assessments to identify operational weaknesses and areas requiring remediation
- Produce detailed ODD reports that summarise findings, risks, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders
- Ensure suppliers enable the life company to adhere to relevant internal policies, frameworks as well as its regulatory obligations (e.g., Solvency II, PRA, FCA SYSC 8, outsourcing guidelines, operational resilience requirements),
- Track and manage supplier risk events, incidents, and near-misses through to closure, ensuring suppliers provide root-cause analyses and remediation plans
- Maintain an up-to-date supplier register and ensure accurate risk classifications

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at MG Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. jobDescription:
Company Description

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.


Job Description

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to help shape and build the next generation of Agentic AI and AI-powered engineering systems at Blend360.

This is not a traditional GenAI or chatbot development role. We are looking for an experienced software/AI engineer who understands how to build production-grade agentic systems and, importantly, how to leverage Agentic Engineering as part of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

You will work across AI engineering, software architecture, agent orchestration, LLM applications, developer productivity, and AI-assisted software development. You will help establish engineering practices around AI agents, context engineering, tool use, evaluations, autonomous task execution, and AI-augmented development workflows.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating real-world Agentic AI systems.


What You'll Do

Agentic Engineering & AI-Augmented SDLC

  • Drive the adoption of Agentic Engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, using AI agents to augment and automate engineering workflows.
  • Leverage tools and approaches such as Claude Code, Claude Code Skills, PI, Hermes Agent, and comparable AI coding/engineering agents as part of day-to-day software development.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows covering requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and deployment.
  • Design agent workflows capable of understanding large codebases, managing context, using tools, executing multi-step engineering tasks, and recovering from failures.
  • Establish best practices around context management, context engineering, tool calling, agent orchestration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and autonomous task execution.
  • Design and implement Evals to measure agent correctness, reliability, code quality, task completion, regression, and overall effectiveness.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging agentic coding tools and techniques and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Production-Grade Agentic AI

  • Architect and develop multi-agent and agentic systems capable of performing complex, multi-step tasks in production environments.
  • Design agent architectures involving planning, reasoning, tool use, memory/context, execution, reflection, validation, and error recovery.
  • Build agents that integrate with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, developer tools, and other external services.
  • Develop reliable tool-use and MCP-based integrations where appropriate.
  • Build production-grade LLM applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
  • Implement RAG, semantic search, vector retrieval, structured outputs, and other LLM application patterns where required.
  • Establish appropriate observability, evaluation, monitoring, security, and guardrails for agentic applications.

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Provide technical leadership across the design and development of AI-powered software products and platforms.
  • Apply strong software engineering principles including system design, modular architecture, API design, scalability, reliability, testing, CI/CD, and maintainability.
  • Build production-quality services and APIs using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, data, and client teams to translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and provide mentorship to other AI/software engineers.
  • Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI and agentic applications.

Leadership & Innovation

  • Act as a technical leader for Agentic AI initiatives and influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams.
  • Mentor engineers on AI engineering, agentic architectures, software engineering practices, and AI-assisted development.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving AI coding agents, agent frameworks, LLM capabilities, evaluation methodologies, and engineering practices.
  • Prototype emerging technologies and transition successful approaches into reliable production solutions.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities where Agentic AI can deliver measurable business and engineering value.

Qualifications

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering / AI engineering experience, with strong hands-on development experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building production-grade applications and services.
  • Demonstrable experience building production-grade Agentic AI systems, beyond simple chatbots or basic RAG applications.
  • Strong understanding of Agentic Evaluation / Agent Evals, including designing evaluation frameworks for autonomous and multi-agent systems.
  • Experience creating evaluation datasets, test scenarios, metrics, automated regression tests, and quality gates for agentic applications.
  • Ability to evaluate agents beyond final-answer accuracy, including planning, tool use, reasoning trajectory, context handling, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern backend/API development.
  • Experience with LLMs, GenAI, agent orchestration, tool calling, and RAG.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of multi-agent architectures, planning, reasoning, context management, tool use, memory, and agent execution.
  • Experience working with Evals / evaluation frameworks to measure and improve AI/agent performance.
  • Experience with cloud, containers, CI/CD, APIs, databases, and production deployments.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, debugging, testing, scalability, and production engineering practices.

Agentic Engineering Critical Requirement

The candidate should have practical exposure to using AI agents as engineering tools within the SDLC, not simply developing AI applications.

Experience with tools such as:

  • Claude Code / Claude Code Skills
  • PI
  • Hermes Agent
  • AI coding agents or comparable agentic development platforms

is highly valuable.

Candidates should understand how to use these tools for activities such as:

Context management code generation repository understanding implementation testing debugging code review evaluation iteration


Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and building MCP servers/tools.
  • Experience with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, or other frontier models.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience with LLM observability and tracing.
  • Experience with tools such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
  • Experience implementing automated agent evaluations, regression testing, and quality gates.
  • Experience with distributed systems and scalable AI inference.
  • Experience working in consulting/client-facing environments.

Additional Information

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Build and scale production-grade Agentic AI systems, not just prototypes or chatbots.
  • Help Blend360 adopt Agentic Engineering across the SDLC.
  • Improve developer productivity through AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • Establish repeatable approaches for context engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, and Evals.
  • Help teams safely adopt AI coding agents such as Claude Code, PI, Hermes Agent, and emerging equivalents.
  • Raise the engineering quality, reliability, and scalability of AI solutions delivered to clients.

  • Multi-Cloud Core Networking: Build, scale, and maintain Okta's multi-cloud backbone across AWS and GCP. Actively architect clean hub-and-spoke models utilizing AWS Transit Gateway (TGW), AWS Global Accelerator (AGA), and GCP Network Connectivity Center to unify converged enterprise product networks (Harmony).

title: Sr. Consultant
jobDescription:
Trinity is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our growing Analytics organization with a focus on delivering data and AI-enabled analytics solutions. This role blends strong analytics execution, business understanding and practical application of AI (including GenAI and LLM-based approaches) across commercial use cases.
Trinity is a 1400-person, global organization that partners with ~350 life sciences companies annually. At the highest level, we provide Strategy, Insights, and Analytics support. Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions).
Trinity is investing in expanding our Analytics Strategy team, a seller-doer group that owns client relationships and overall account delivery. Senior Consultants are responsible for delivery excellence, while helping scale Trinity s AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to join an established firm and work in an entrepreneurial environment, building and scaling a fast-growing team within a core strategic priority area for Trinity.
Position Summary
Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant. The EAD team acts as the pan-analytics backbone, orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs. The Consultant is responsible for:
  • Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact
  • Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML)
The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context.
Position Responsibilities:
This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with
seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC.
Delivery Leadership
  • Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations.
  • Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive)
  • Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the contextual why for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools
  • Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution
  • Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity s technology solutions in client environments.
Mentoring and Coaching
  • Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness.
  • Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship.
  • Teach junior team members how to use AI tools and automation responsibly in analytics delivery and operational workflows.
  • Support capability building across the EAD team by identifying development opportunities and helping junior staff grow.
Business Development Support
  • Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed.
  • Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelors degree in a quantitative, technical, scientific, business, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of direct work experience in a related field (life sciences consulting, biopharma analytics, and/or general consulting).
Other Important Skills:
  • Experience in life sciences, including healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or medtech business questions and data.
  • Strong proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python, with the ability to execute and review complex analyses.
  • Experience across commercial, market, customer, and evidence-generation use cases, including
forecasting, segmentation, sales or performance analytics, access analytics, and advanced modeling.
  • Familiarity with statistical modeling, scenario analysis, machine learning, deployment-oriented workflows, and AI-enabled productivity or automation tools.
  • Experience managing and mentoring junior team members in a professional services, consulting, or analytics environment.
  • Knowledge of implementing custom AI Agents is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer II
jobDescription:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer II with strong hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and container technologies.
The DevOps Engineer II will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps solutions, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure and operational activities, troubleshooting issues, and supporting application teams across multiple environments.
The ideal candidate should be able to work independently on well-defined requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to improving existing DevOps frameworks and standards.
Key Responsibilities:
CI/CD:
  • Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Configure pipelines for application build, testing, packaging, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures.
  • Integrate unit testing, code-quality checks, security scanning, and other required quality gates.
  • Work with existing shared pipeline libraries, templates, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual deployment activities through automation.
  • Support application deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
AWS & Cloud Infrastructure:
  • Provision and support infrastructure primarily in AWS.
  • Work with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, EKS, IAM, VPC, ALB, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, and SSM.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, IAM, DNS, and application connectivity issues.
  • Support infrastructure changes across multiple environments.
  • Follow established cloud architecture, security, tagging, and operational standards.
Infrastructure as Code:
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Modify and enhance existing Terraform modules.
  • Create Terraform configurations for new infrastructure requirements.
  • Troubleshoot Terraform plan and apply failures.
  • Manage environment-specific Terraform configurations.
  • Participate in peer reviews of Infrastructure as Code changes.
  • Follow established Terraform and IaC standards.
Automation & Configuration Management:
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for server configuration and application deployment.
  • Automate operational activities using Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them.
  • Maintain and improve existing automation.
  • Troubleshoot automation failures and implement permanent fixes where possible.
Containers & Kubernetes:
  • Build and troubleshoot Docker containers.
  • Deploy and support applications running on Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Work with Kubernetes resources including:
  • Pods
  • Deployments
  • Services
  • ConfigMaps
  • Secrets
  • Ingress
  • Persistent storage
  • Work with Helm charts for application deployment and configuration.
  • Troubleshoot container startup, deployment, networking, configuration, and resource issues.
  • Basic experience with ECS/Fargate is beneficial.
Monitoring & Troubleshooting:
  • Monitor infrastructure and application health using tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, and application environment issues.
  • Investigate alerts and operational incidents.
  • Participate in root cause analysis.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend automation or permanent fixes.
  • Support lower and production environments as required.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation where applicable.
Platform & Developer Enablement:
  • Support Engineering teams in adopting established DevOps and platform standards.
  • Contribute to reusable CI/CD, infrastructure, and automation solutions.
  • Help automate common Engineering requests.
  • Contribute to developer self-service capabilities.
  • Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Share technical knowledge with team members.
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS.
  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience building and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with Ansible or similar configuration-management tools.
  • Working experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of Helm.
  • Experience with Git and pull-request-based development workflows.
  • Scripting experience using at least one of: PowerShell, Bash and Python.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration.
  • Understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, Load balancers, Firewalls/Security Groups, VPCs/Subnets and Routing.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with AWS EKS, ECS, or Fargate.
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD.
  • Experience with SonarQube, Trivy, or other security/code-quality tools.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.
  • AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, or other relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Key Competencies:
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Automation-first mindset.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned technical requirements.
  • Good understanding of DevOps practices and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering, Platform, CloudOps, Security, and other teams.
  • Ability to identify recurring problems and contribute to permanent solutions.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve technical skills.
Level II Expectations
A DevOps Engineer II should be able to:
  • Independently complete well-defined DevOps tasks.
  • Build and modify CI/CD pipelines using established frameworks.
  • Provision and modify AWS infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible automation.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot containerized workloads.
  • Troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
  • Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them.
  • Follow established architecture, security, and engineering standards.
  • Contribute improvements to existing frameworks and reusable solutions.
  • Support and share knowledge with junior team members.
Behavioral Competencies
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Balances Stakeholders
  • Collaborates Effectively
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Profit & Loss Manager
jobDescription:
ASB Academy is looking for a commercially strong and entrepreneurial Profit & Loss Manager to take ownership of business growth, revenue and profitability.

This is a leadership opportunity for someone who sees beyond a sales target and understands the complete business - market opportunity, customer acquisition, revenue, pricing, partnerships, costs, margins, people and profitability. We are looking for an individual who can think like a business owner, act with autonomy and deliver measurable outcomes. The person in this role will be expected to shape business strategy, identify growth opportunities, build and strengthen revenue channels, lead teams and take accountability for the overall commercial performance of the business.

The Opportunity
ASB operates at the intersection of EdTech, with learning and capability-building offerings across areas including Blockchain, IT, AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing and emerging technologies. The business serves multiple segments including individuals, universities, corporates and government.
This creates an opportunity for a business leader who can identify where the strongest commercial opportunities lie, build the right go-to-market approach and turn those opportunities into sustainable and profitable growth.

What You Will Own
Your mandate will span the complete business cycle:
Market Strategy Go-to-Market Sales Revenue Customers Partnerships Costs Margins Profitability Scale
You will be accountable for the outcome, not simply the activity.

P&L & Business Ownership
  • Own the end-to-end P&L of the assigned business and take accountability for revenue, costs, margins and profitability.
  • Develop annual and quarterly business plans aligned with growth and profitability objectives.
  • Translate business goals into clear commercial strategies, priorities and execution plans.
  • Own revenue forecasting, budgeting and business performance planning.
  • Monitor business economics and identify opportunities to improve margins, pricing, cost efficiency and contribution.
  • Make commercially sound decisions based on financial data, customer insights and market intelligence.
  • Identify underperforming areas early and take decisive corrective action.
  • Maintain a strong balance between growth, investment, customer value and profitability.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility on business performance, risks, opportunities and the actions required.

  • Identify high-value markets, customer segments, accounts and channels.

  • Develop strategies to improve acquisition, conversion, retention and customer lifetime value.
  • Lead strategic and high-value customer conversations and negotiations.

  • Build and expand strategic partnerships and channels to create new sources of revenue.

Strategic Partnerships & Institutional Business

  • Identify partnership opportunities that can create meaningful business value and scalable revenue.

  • Establish clear targets, ownership areas and performance expectations.
  • Create a culture focused on accountability, commercial thinking and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop team capability across sales, negotiation, relationship management and business development.

tagsAndSkills: ci/cd pipelines,business requirements,ai,articulate,communication and interpersonal skills,analytical skills,aurora,azure cloud
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect. Division: Assessment & Qualifications Delivery. Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid).

Role Summary: As a Solution Architect (E30), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson's enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end-to-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
  • Solution Option Analysis & Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
  • Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams-including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers-to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
  • Vendor Oversight: Work with third-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson's standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
  • Documentation & Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost-effective solutions.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
  • Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.

Essential Experience & Skills

  • Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud-native principles.
  • Architecture & Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
  • Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
  • Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
  • Solution Analysis & Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
  • Problem Solving & Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
  • Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
  • Education & Certification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; Master's degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.

Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
  • Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
  • Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
  • Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.

Job Location and Hours

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.
